messages:
anya_sec: Quick heads-up: scheduling a tiny canary rebuild at 03:00 UTC to fold in an urgent libc patch. Need KMS signer window + RBAC review. Who can own the key bind and confirm audit sinks?

ash_infra: I can do the key alias and binding. Will grant a 3h time-limited signer role to sa-rebuild-canary and dry-run in staging first.

dan_runtime: Ill run the canary smoke tests and perf check. Tag?

anya_sec: Tag will be canary-1723459999 pushed to gcr.io/redwood/base-image. KMS path: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign-main -> alias cosign-canary-2026-04. Roles: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner + roles/cloudkms.viewer.

ash_infra: Command (staging dry-run):
```bash
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding cosign-canary-2026-04 \\
  --keyring=rebuild --location=global --member="serviceAccount:sa-rebuild-canary@redwood-infra" \\
  --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner"
```

anya_sec: Important: the pipeline must use least privilege role roles/redwood.rebuildCanary. @dan_runtime can you update GH workflow to use workload identity mapping for the canary only?

dan_runtime: Yep, will open PR. Ill include cosign verify step: `cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign-canary-2026-04 gcr.io/redwood/base-image:canary-1723459999`

sam_oncall: Ill monitor the war-room and check that KMS sign actions and GCR push land in logs-to-splunk-prod sink within 15m. If unexpected IAM grants appear Ill signal rollback.

ash_infra: Staging dry-run succeeded. Scheduling prod binding at 02:45 UTC; revoke at 06:00 UTC.

anya_sec: Checklist after push: 1) cosign verify OK 2) smoke script ./scripts/smoke-canary.sh canary-1723459999 passes 3) KMS sign log + GCR push show in sink 4) confirm no broad roles granted to pipeline SA. Leave thread open until audit+smoke green.
